name: JWST_BENCH_papers
description:
JWST_BENCH_Dataset
	

Curated, structured metadata for JWST-era astrophysics papers used in the JWST-Bench / HypoGen workflow.
Each row is one paper with bibliographic fields (title, authors, arXiv id, links) and compact research-oriented fields (framework, predictions, simulation details, observations, conclusions, caveats). This table is meant to be a clean input for hypothesis generation, evidence retrieval, and meta-analysis.

Rows: 637  
Columns: 19  
Format: CSV (delimiter: ;)… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Shashwat20/JWST_BENCH_papers.
evaluation_method: metadata extraction: exact_match / F1; evidence retrieval: retrieval metrics (e.g., recall@k) and human_eval for higher-level fields
reputation: A targeted, domain-specific dataset used in JWST-Bench workflows and hypothesis-generation pipelines; modest adoption among astronomy and computational-documentation researchers.
